decisions.decision: Use conda-forge for mujoco 2.3.7 instead of pip source build
decisions.rationale: Colab Python 3.12 removed distutils; mujoco 2.3.7 setup.py uses distutils and has no cp312 pip wheel. conda-forge has pre-compiled binaries for all Python versions.
numpy 1.22.4 has no cp311/cp312 binary wheel; source build requires Cython+Fortran. numpy 1.24+ has cp312 wheels and LIBERO is compatible.
opencv 4.6.0.66 has no cp311/cp312 binary wheel; source build is huge. 4.7+ has cp312 wheels.
